== English Death Star II comparison ==
The official exact replacement changes the 7-side captive transfer condition and expressly retains the printed 0 side. The E-marked printable slip matches. Current publisher full back still displays the original ‘if present’, even though the revised slip and Appendices agree. This is an independently supported missing article. Preserve verified matching unchanged front if available and use the verified E back slip or documentary reference; do not show the stale back as the new state. A numeric article/engine role requires independently sourced existing mapping.
